name: Sen'jin Village Outskirts
summary: The Sen'jin Village Outskirts encompass the arid, sun-scorched fringes surrounding the primary Darkspear troll settlement in Durotar. Ringed by red rock ridges and the nearby eastern coast, these plains separate the fragile coastal refuge from the harsher wilderness inland.

sections.title: On the Village Boundary
sections.body: Spreading out around Sen'jin Village, the outskirts form a rugged buffer zone between the Darkspear settlement and the untamed wilds of southern Durotar. The terrain is dominated by dry red dirt, sparse scrubland, and sheer crags overlooking the Great Sea. For young troll warriors and shamans, these perimeter lands represent their first taste of the wilderness, serving as the frontline against roving wildlife, Kul Tiras scouts from the coast, and lingering hostile threats eager to strike at the fledgling troll sanctuary.

faq.q: What is the Sen'jin Village Outskirts?
faq.answer: It is the open wilderness immediately surrounding Sen'jin Village in southern Durotar, serving as a boundary between the troll settlement and the surrounding arid plains.

faq.q: Why is this area important to the Darkspear?
faq.answer: Having recently fled their flooded island home in the South Seas and lost the Echo Isles to Zalazane, the Darkspear rely on this perimeter to guard their primary coastal foothold on Kalimdor.
The open perimeter sees roaming scorpid, feral boars, and human interlopers scouting up from the southern shoreline, threatening the safety of the nearby village.

angles.text: Every young Darkspear remembers cutting their teeth in the dusty reaches around Sen'jin, proving they can protect the tribe's last haven on the Durotar coast.
Holding the southern approaches to Sen'jin Village keeps the Darkspear secure and prevents hostile incursions from moving further north toward Orgrimmar.
